requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate correct parsing of inclusion and exclusion sections from well-formed eligibility criteria text.
The system must include unit tests that verify strictness scores increase as the number of exclusion criteria increases.
The system must include unit tests that verify strictness scores decrease for trials with minimal eligibility criteria.
The system must include unit tests that validate strictness score normalization to a 0–1 range.
The system must include unit tests that confirm demographic restrictions (e.g., age, gender) increase strictness score relative to unrestricted trials.
The system must include unit tests that validate higher strictness scores for trials with complex medical exclusions compared to simple exclusions.
The system must include unit tests that confirm consistent scoring output for identical eligibility input across multiple runs.
The system must include unit tests that validate parsing and scoring behavior when only inclusion criteria are present.
The system must include unit tests that validate parsing and scoring behavior when only exclusion criteria are present.
The system must include unit tests that validate scoring behavior for highly restrictive trials with numerous exclusion rules.
The system must include unit tests that confirm graceful handling of malformed eligibility text without raising unhandled exceptions.
The system must include unit tests that verify a default or fallback strictness score is returned when eligibility text is missing or empty.
The system must include unit tests that validate correct tokenization or segmentation of eligibility criteria into individual rules.
The system must include unit tests that verify scoring logic does not double-count duplicated criteria entries.
The system must include unit tests that validate robustness to irregular formatting such as bullet points, line breaks, and mixed casing.
The system must include unit tests that confirm scoring output aligns with expected values for predefined sample trials with known strictness levels.
The system must include unit tests that validate the scoring function returns structured output conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-M7-S1.
The system must include unit tests that simulate LLM-parsed eligibility inputs and verify scoring behaves consistently with deterministic parsing outputs.
